ModMetadata.Name: Better Loading Screens [StationeersLaunchPad]
ModMetadata.Author: vinus
ModMetadata.Description:
[h1]Better Loading Screens[/h1] [b]WARNING:[/b] This is a StationeersLaunchPad Plugin Mod. It requires Bepinex to be installed with the StationeersLaunchPad plugin. See: https://github.com/StationeersLaunchPad/StationeersLaunchPad
Most images are from Rocketwerks, so props to them for that, and their update artwork. If you want your base/images included feel free to dm me on discord @vinuswastaken or ping me in the Stationeers discord Adds many many new loading screen images, plus allows users to add their own loading screens, and disable the default one in config. The path for custom loading screens is [i]Documents\My Games\Stationeers\loadingscreens[/i]
you can also go here to get the dll itself if you want to just put it in your bepinex/plugins folder: https://github.com/TerameTechYT/StationeersSharp/
